scripts.type-check: pnpm -r --filter='./apps/**' run type-check && pnpm -r --filter='./packages/shared-types' run type-check
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:seed: pnpm exec prisma db seed --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:reset: pnpm exec prisma migrate reset --force --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
